title: CSG’s Digitalization - Maintenance management topic
description:
In the context of CSG’s Digitalization process whose goal is to :
•	Reduce re configuration delay in between two launches
•	Maintenance and Operation reduction costs
•	Turn the CSG into an attractive spot for new space operators
•	Improve space base availability
•	Daily life improvement and simplification
The CSG will capitalize on the basis that was set by the ‘Socle Numérique Transverse (SNT)’ project in order to bring a brand new Information System.
The global scope that the digitalization services must address are:
•	Satellites’ and launch campaigns operations
•	Maintenance and sustainability (in line with the SNT project)
•	CSG’s space base Infrastructures (physical, software or virtual) (mainly for networks and informatics)
•	Security, Safety and protection 
•	Daily life improvement and simplification
•	Communication
•	Datacenters
•	Projects valorization and marketability
•	Process improvements and optimization
•	Radars and Simulations
In order to match those needs, the project teams will be organized according to the following topics:
•	IT Networks
•	Planification and Task/Operation management
•	Maintenance management
•	Technical fact management
•	Data management
•	IT Hardware
•	Right profile and access management
•	Safety and Security
•	Information Broadcast
•	Radar and Launcher Simulation
Two transversal teams will be in charge of the global consistency of the projects for planning and architectural/urbanization purposes
This publication concerns the Maintenance management topic
The expected services provision for each of those items are:
•	Architecture and urbanization of the systems, taken into account Maintenance and optimizations 
•	Project Management officer. Projects will have to be managed through a project’s portfolio. Team guidance for steps definition and planning formalization, accurate indicators follow up.
•	Requirements analysis and formalization of the projects that will be designed to meet those requirements.
•	Project owner support for specification redaction for each identified project, document redaction and accurate technical descriptions 
•	Market surveys and state of art
•	Analysis reports of studied solutions
•	Proof of concept based on the solution identified and validation
•	Project management for design, development, implementation and deployment of the identified projects
•	Providing the solutions and implements them (could be external solutions of specialized editors and vendors)
•	Support and coaching for information security analysis 
•	On-site installation (when necessary) and global system technical validation. The holder of the contract will be responsible of the supplies that will be plugged with CNES CSG’s equipment.
•	Training of the staff that will be in charge of the exploitation of the systems to ensure its autonomy
•	Users and administrators training.
•	Ensure the maintainability and the sustainability of the systems and projects 
•	Ensure knowledge transfer and reversibility to the CNES teams in order to ensure the ability to keep going with Project management, urbanization and mastering the new deployed tools 
These services therefore provide the entire life cycle of the projects that will arise from each of the topic.
All items will have to be compliant with CNES CSG's context and constraints
Although this publication is specific to a given topic, the tenderer must ensure the mutual consistency of the projects. He will have to coordinate with the teams in charge of planning and the overall architecture of the systems.

title: Achizitia de produse de resort tehnic prevazute in cadrul proiectului ”Improved guarding and intervention in Maramureș and Ivano-Frankivsk natural protected areas” finanțat din Programul Interreg NEXT România-Ucraina 2021-2027, cod proiect ROUA00138
description:
Obiectul contractului: Furnizarea de Autovehicul de patrulare plug in hybrid (minim 6+1 locuri), Autovehiculele de intervenţie în mediul montan - tip UTV, Autovehicule pentru deplasare pe zăpadă, Remorcă auto pentru transport, ATV/UTV/snowmobile, Echipamente de salvare şi supravuiţuire pentru echipaje, Terminal comunicații prin satelit, Terminal radio portabil VHF și GPS portabil și livrarea acestora la sediul autorităţii contractante (UM 0716 Baia Mare – Inspectoratul de Jandarmi Județean Maramureș). În urma analizării la nivelul Inspectoratului de Jandarmi Județean Maramureș a nivelului dotării și capacității de intervenție în domeniul protejării biodiversității naturale, s-a constatat necesitatea achiziționării unor echipamente și mijloace specifice pentru executarea misiunilor în siguranță de către personalul Inspectoratului de Jandarmi Județean Maramureș, pentru atingerea obiectivului de consolidare a protecției și conservării naturii, biodiversității, infrastructurii verzi, și silviculturii în zona transfrontalieră româno-ucraineană. Obiectiv specific este consolidarea protecției și conservării naturii, biodiversității, infrastructurii verzi, și silviculturii în zona transfrontalieră româno-ucraineană. Scopul achiziției este îndeplinirea obiectivului proiectului prin sporirea dotarii și pregătirii personalului operativ în vederea dezvoltării unor strategii inovatoare pentru consolidarea supravegherii, controlului, conservării și protejării fondului forestier, în scopul protejării biodiversității. Astfel, prin achiziționarea echipamentelor se va reduce timpul de reacție, respectiv deplasarea forțelor în timp util și eficient și supravegherea în bune condiții a zonei de interes, sporind eficiența forțelor de ordine implicate. Operatorii economici interesați pot solicita clarificări/informații suplimentare până în a 18-a zi înainte de termenul de limită de depunere a ofertelor. Autoritatea contractantă va răspunde, în mod clar și competent, tuturor solicitărilor de clarificare/ informații suplimentare cu 11 zile înainte de termenul de depunere a ofertelor.

title: Lahden kaupungin katuverkon digitaalinen kopio
description: Hankittava kokonaisuus koostuu katutilakopion tuotantoon jo todennetusti soveltuvista ja vakiintuneista osista, sisältäen datan keräämisen, käsittelyn ja prosessoinnin tietosuoja- sekä tietoturvavaatimusten mukaisesti ja myös olennaisena osana datan esittämisen visuaalisena kopiona 31.12.2026 saakka SaaS -palveluna. Lisäksi hankinnassa on mahdollinen yhden tai kahden vuoden optiokausi. Optio-kauden käyttämisestä ja pituudesta päättää tilaaja, mutta molemmat osapuolet hyväksyvät optiokausien käytön. Hankinnan osat: 1. 360°-katunäkymäkuvat 2. Mobiili laserkeilaus 3. SaaS -alustaratkaisu 4. Liikennemerkkien inventointi Lahden kaupungin kaupunkiympäristön toimialan tavoitteena on hankkia organisaation toiminnan pohjaksi kustannuksia optimoiva ja ajantasainen digitaalinen kopio katutilasta varusteineen ja laitteineen matkalla kohti digitaalista kaksosta. Tavoitteena on edelleen tulevaisuudessa muodostaa tosimaailman asiaintilaa edustava datamalli, jonka tarkkuus voi vaihdella kopion (kaksosen) sisällä (mukautuva tarkkuus). Data voi koskea esimerkiksi yhtä katutilaa, sen yhtä liikennemerkkiä, muuta ulkoista olemusta tai kuntotilaa (tämänhetkistä tai historiallista). Lisäksi tämän hankinnan yhtenä tavoitteena on laatia toimintamalli digitaalisen katutilakopion ylläpitoprosessiksi tulevaisuuden tarpeet huomioiden. Yhden kadun tai liikennemerkin visuaalisessa digitaalisessa kopiossa jokaisella pikselillä voi olla omaisuustietoa tai se voi esiintyä vain visuaalisena kuvana, ilman että pikseleihin on upotettu varsinaista omaisuusdataa. Parhaassa tapauksessa tulevaisuudessa, kun dataa on kerätty kopioon käytännön toiminnasta pitkällä aikavälillä (vuosikymmen +), kuntotilan kehittymistä voidaan myös alkaa simuloimaan (digitaalinen kaksonen). Simulointi on siis mahdollista digitaalisessa kaksosessa, mutta ei välttämättä digitaalisessa kopiossa. Kun dataa ei vielä yleisesti ole paljoa valmiiksi tuotettuna, sitä voidaan tässä hankittavassa katutilakopiossa myös generoida itse esimerkiksi: 1. Visualisoimalla dataekosysteemin muuta omaisuusdataa katutilakopiossa, hyödyntäen rajapintoja dataekosysteemin muihin moduuleihin (InfraWEB, Trimble Locus) 2. Tuottamalla ja tallentamalla mittauksia itse katutilakopiossa 3. Tallentamalla dataa suoraan katutilakopioon Katutilakopiodataa voidaan päivittää joko jatkuvasti (dynaaminen) tai harvemmin (staattinen), riippuen datan käyttökohteesta ja käyttötarpeesta. Digitaalinen kopio on askel kohti digitaalista kaksosta, joka taasen mahdollistaa simuloinnin, eli ennakoivan kunnossapidon ja rakennetun ympäristön omaisuuserien elinkaaren dataan perustuvan hallinnan.

title: RFP 250029 - CALL FOR TENDER – PROCUREMENT OF PAPER BOOKS
description: The University of Luxembourg is launching this call for tenders with the objective of concluding a Framework Agreement for the procurement of books in paper format, including academic publications and conference proceedings, to support its teaching and research activities. The publications shall cover a wide array of disciplines such as: - Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine - Law, Economics and Finance - Education & Social Work, Behavioural & Cognitive Sciences, Humanities, Social Sciences, Geography & Spatial Planning - Security, Reliability and Trust - Systems Biomedicine - Contemporary and Digital History - European Law - Socio-Environmental Systems. This list is non-exhaustive, and the University reserves the right to request documentation in additional subject areas as necessary. Excluded from the scope of this contract are publications issued by the University of Luxembourg as well as works that are exclusively distributed by the publishers. The Framework Agreement shall encompass the following services and supplies: - Provision of bibliographic and pricing information for requested titles; - Submission of price quotations upon request; - Supply and delivery of books to the University; - Issuance of invoices in compliance with the University's administrative requirements; - Participation in an annual performance review meeting with University representatives; - Provision and maintenance of an online ordering platform that enables University staff to search for titles, submit orders, and track deliveries. This platform is an essential component of the present procurement procedure and it must be operational throughout the duration of the agreement. The present call for tenders is intended to result in the conclusion of a Framework Agreement for an initial period of one (1) year, renewable three (3) times for successive one (1) year periods (1+1+1+1), subject to the University’s decision and performance evaluation. The Framework Agreement will be concluded with one (1) contractor per lot. No reopening of competition shall occur during the validity of the agreement. title: Gym. Budějovická, P4-přestavba tělocvičny na sál — Gym. Budějovická, P4 - přestavba tělocvičny na sál
description: Gym. Budějovická, P4 - přestavba tělocvičny na sál Předmětem plnění veřejné zakázky je rekonstrukce a přestavba vnitřního prostoru squashové haly na multifunkční sál. Vnější vzhled stavby zůstane prakticky nezměněn. Rovněž se nebude zasahovat do dalších přístaveb souvisejících s provozem haly. Celý vnitřní prostor bude kompletně zrekonstruován. Budou kompletně vyměněny vnitřní povrchy, které budou řešeny formou akustických obkladů stěn a podhledů. Materiálové řešení spočívá v kombinaci přírodního dřeva, šedých a bílých ploch stěn. Do sálu budou vybudovány dva vstupy. Jeden nový z interiéru školy v západní stěně dvoupodlažního objektu šaten, kterým bude umožněn přímý vstup z chodby školy dvoukřídlými dveřmi. Druhý vstup do sálu z této chodby bude novými dvoukřídlými dveřmi. Základní uspořádání hlediště a jeviště je symetrické, na podélné ose, vložené na střed šířky jižního štítu. V jižní zúžené části sálu bude instalována teleskopická tribuna tvořící hlediště. Přízemní část sálu je přístupná bezbariérovým vstupem z přilehlého terénu. title: Germany – Pharmaceutical products – Abschluss einer nicht-exklusiven Rabattvereinbarung nach § 130a Abs. 8 SGB V zum Wirkstoff Safinamid, ATC N04BD03 für die Zeit 01.08.2025 - 31.07.2027 (zzgl. Verlängerungsoption 1x12 Monate)
description: § 130a Absatz 8 SGB V ermöglicht den Krankenkassen und pharmazeutischen Unternehmen, Rahmenrabattverträge über die zu Lasten der gesetzlichen Krankenkassen abzugebenden Arzneimittel zuschließen. In Hinblick auf die dafür einschlägigen gesetzlichen Vorschriften zur Vergabe öffentlicher Aufträge, findet ein regelmäßiger Prozess wirkstoffbezogener, förmlicher Vergabeverfahren nach den Regularien des 4. Teils des GWB durch die DAK-Gesundheit statt. Für vom Bieter näher in der Anlage 2 zum Vertrag zu benennende Arzneimittel zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff Safinamid, ATC N04BD03, beabsichtigt die DAK-Gesundheit, bis zum Inkrafttreten neuer Arzneimittelrabattverträge mit möglichst allen interessierten pharmazeutischen Unternehmen Arzneimittelrabattverträge abzuschließen. Ein Rabattvertrag i.R.d. Zulassungsmodells zu dem o. g. Wirkstoff tritt erstmals am 01.08.2025 in Kraft und endet am 31.07.2027 (zzgl. Verlängerungsoption 1x12 Monate). Er endet unabhängig davon automatisch mit Inkrafttreten des Exklusivvertrages.
